full_text_zh:
[P1] 水男孩和他的喷泉
L'uomo d'acqua
e la sua fontana
[意]伊沃·罗萨缇 / 著 [意]加布里埃尔·帕切科 / 绘 张喆 / 译
云南出版集团公司

[P2] L'uomo d'acqua
e la sua fontana
水男孩和他的喷泉
[意]伊沃·罗萨缇 / 著 [意]加布里埃尔·帕切科 / 绘 张喆 / 译

云南出版集团公司
晨光出版社
2/16

[P3] 滴答，滴答……水轻轻落进洗手池，一分钟又
一分钟，一小时又一小时。
房子的主人忘记关紧水龙头。没人知道他去了
哪儿，可能是斐济岛，也可能是传说中非洲某个出
产蓝色金矿的地方。
水一直滴，不紧不慢，不急不缓，从未停息。
一天又一天，一年又一年。水流淌着、聚集着，最
后，竟然变成了一个蓝色水晶般透明的大男孩。
没错。
他真的是一个用水做成的大男孩。
当水滴汇聚成他的刘海儿时，水男孩醒了。
他跳出洗手池，自言自语着：
“究竟发生了什么事儿？”

[P4] 真实的世界呈现在他的眼前：墙壁、沥青、塑料瓶，还有一摞纸。水男孩，这个水做的人，却没有停下脚步仔细看看这一切。他直冲下楼梯，来到门外，朝大海、湖泊甚至小溪走去。
人们好奇地围着水男孩，有人把他当成水坑，有人说他像喷泉，还有人觉得他只是影子或幻觉。没人知道他是怎样走路的，更没人知道他为什么会存在。
“对不起，先生，你这是要去哪儿啊？”
“到处转转。”
“可你不能随便走动！弄得到处都是水，这可不行！”
“我只是想四处走走。”
“快报警！”有人大喊，
“这家伙弄得到处都是水！”，

[P5] 眼看门廊被淹，看门的大婶气得简直要发疯。一个
头戴高帽的男人挥舞着雨伞
冲水男孩发火——因为水男孩擤个鼻涕竟然掀起了四人
高的巨浪。
“你不冷吗？”人们
问，“为什么不像我们一样
穿上衣服呢？”

[P6] 有一天，水男孩不见了，没有说一句话。很快，追捕他的消息就传遍了大街小巷，连他的照片都上了报纸头条。警察希望快点儿找到他，哪怕是水蒸气的样子都行。他们还警告人们不要接近水男孩，更不能到他那里喝水、洗手。
趁着月色，水男孩悄悄溜出来，默默站在墙角。有时候，他浇浇花；有时候，他帮忙冲洗汽车；还有时候，他给小狗冲澡，给流浪汉的空瓶子灌满清水。
水男孩在用心感受着这个世界......

[P7] 白天，很难看到水男孩的身影。阳光下，他的双手会慢慢蒸发，头发会渐渐消失，双脚也会被晒得湿漉漉。那时，他就赶紧躲到阴影里，稍微休息一会儿。渐渐地，水男孩就又变回到清澈透明的蓝色。
阴天时，水男孩感觉最舒服，他那精致的轮廓清晰可见。
水男孩从不口渴，从不洗澡，也从不上厕所；既不会饿，更不会困，其实他连什么是睡觉都不知道。

[P8] 白天，很难看到水男孩的身影。阳光下，他的双手会慢慢蒸发，头发会渐渐消失，双脚也会被晒得湿漉漉。那时，他就赶紧躲到阴影里，稍微休息一会儿。渐渐地，水男孩就又变回到清澈透明的蓝色。
阴天时，水男孩感觉最舒服，他那精致的轮廓清晰可见。
水男孩从不口渴，从不洗澡，也从不上厕所；既不会饿，更不会困，其实他连什么是睡觉都不知道。

[P9] 路上，如果有行人发现水男孩，就会指着他大喊：
“在这儿呢，快叫警察！”
“抓住他，快去拎个水桶，别忘了把水管工叫来！”
一连好几个星期，人们开着水罐车、抽水泵四处寻找水男孩。只要见到他的踪影，就拉响警报。

每次，水男孩都能巧妙避开围堵：
有时藏到井底下，有时蜷缩在瓶子里，
有时还匆忙躲进水坑、水沟甚至下水道里。等一阵混乱过去，他再慢慢从脏水里爬出来，把身上粘着的塑料袋、碎石头和嚼过的口香糖清理干净。

[P10] 每天，水男孩都在四处躲藏，过得很辛苦。他的样子如此与众不同——
有时候，他看上去就像长着腿的塑料瓶子；
有时候，他看上去又像装满海水的购物袋；
有时候，他看上去更像受了委屈、正生闷气的海蜇。
水男孩，他是自然的奇迹……

[P11] 终于，人们慢慢了解了水男孩。晚上，洒水车会向他要些水喝——他们觉得，水男孩给的水最好喝，甘甜无比。
孩子们也张开双臂，对水男孩说：
“你好，请给点儿水，好吗？”
水男孩微笑着，他从不拒绝孩子们的请求。

[P12] 一天，乌云密布，电闪雷鸣，大暴雨来临。硕大的雨点敲打着整座城市，大街小巷全都笼罩在雨水中。雨越下越大，水男孩开心极了，他步入雨中，满心愉悦。这时，一句陌生的呼唤在耳边响起：“回来吧，回到我们身边来！”
水世界的伙伴们在召唤他，那声音飘散在街头巷尾的溪水中，回荡在成千上万的雨滴里。
“回来吧，回到我们身边来！那个到处是汽车、房子的世界不属于你。我们的家在海洋，在河流。
“你属于湖泊、溪流、山泉、雨滴……快回来吧，水男孩，快离开那个奇怪的世界吧！”

[P13] 风雨中传来阵阵低语，缠绕着他，追逐着他，
呼唤着他。但是，水男孩喜欢这个世界。他决定离开城市，遇见的第一个村庄将成为他的新家。
水男孩走啊跑啊，雨滴阵阵落在身上，水世界
伙伴们的声音依稀在耳边：
回来吧，回来吧……

[P14] 走着走着，水男孩眼前出现了一个小村庄。村子里有个石头喷泉，喷泉里还有座石头雕像……
那是一个正撒尿的小男孩。
这个喷泉看上去很久没用过了。水男孩一跳进去，喷泉立刻焕发出了活力。泉水从撒尿小男孩那儿喷了出来，与水男孩融为一体。喷泉成了水男孩的新家。石刻雕像，池边花草，红色锦鲤，生命的鲜活在这一切中涌动着，周而复始地循环着。

[P15] 如果，有一天，你来到了这个小村庄，一定要去看看这座喷泉。如果，有一天，你看到了这座喷泉，一定要多待一会儿。说不定，你会看到喷泉里水男孩若隐若现的笑脸。
有时候，水男孩也会走出喷泉，舒展舒展筋骨。有时候，水男孩也会像我们一样，注视着这个世界。夜深人静时，也许你还会发现水男孩的身影。有人发誓水男孩每晚都会出来走走。
但我还从未见过……
full_text_en:
[P1] The Water Boy and His Fountain
L'uomo d'acqua
e la sua fontana
[It] Ivo Rosati / Author [It] Gabriele Pacheco / Illustrator Zhang Zhe / Translator
Yunnan Publishing Group Company

[P2] L'uomo d'acqua
e la sua fontana
The Water Boy and His Fountain
[Ital.] Ivo Rosati / Author [Ital.] Gabriele Pacheco / Illustrator Zhang Zhe / Translator

Yunnan Publishing Group Company
Chenguang Publishing House
2/16

[P3] Drip, drip... water gently falls into the sink, minute after minute, hour after hour.

The house's owner forgot to turn off the faucet. No one knows where he went—perhaps to Fiji, or maybe to a legendary place in Africa where blue gold mines are said to exist.

The water kept dripping, steady and unhurried, never stopping.

Day after day, year after year. It flowed and gathered, until finally, it became a large boy, transparent and blue like crystal.

That's right.

He was truly a big boy made of water.

When the droplets gathered to form his bangs, the water boy woke up.

He jumped out of the sink, muttering to himself:

"What on earth has happened?"

[P4] The real world appeared before him: walls, asphalt, plastic bottles, and a stack of paper. The water boy, made of water, didn't stop to look at any of it. He rushed down the stairs, out the door, heading toward the sea, lakes, and even small streams.
People curiously surrounded the water boy. Some thought he was a puddle, others said he looked like a fountain, and still others believed he was just a shadow or an illusion. No one knew how he walked, and even fewer knew why he existed.
"Excuse me, sir, where are you going?"
"Just wandering around."
"You can't just walk around! You're making everything wet, and that's not allowed!"
"I just want to walk around."
"Call the police!" someone shouted,
"This guy is making everything wet!"

[P5] Seeing the porch flooded, the doorman's wife was furious. A man wearing a tall hat waved his umbrella at the water boy in anger—because the water boy sneezed and created a giant wave four people tall.
"Aren't you cold?" people asked, "Why don't you wear clothes like we do?"

[P6] One day, the water boy disappeared without saying a word. Soon, news of his capture spread through every street and alley, and even his photo made the front page of the newspaper. The police hoped to find him quickly, even if he was in the form of steam. They also warned people not to approach the water boy, and even more, not to drink or wash their hands at his place.
Under the moonlight, the water boy quietly slipped out and stood silently in the corner of the wall. Sometimes, he watered flowers; sometimes, he helped wash cars; and sometimes, he gave baths to puppies and filled empty bottles for homeless men with clear water.
The water boy was carefully experiencing this world......

[P7] During the day, it was hard to see the water boy. Under the sun, his hands would slowly evaporate, his hair would gradually disappear, and his feet would become damp. At that time, he would quickly hide in the shade and rest for a while. Gradually, the water boy would return to his clear, transparent blue.
On cloudy days, the water boy felt most comfortable, and his delicate outline was clearly visible.
The water boy never felt thirsty, never took a bath, and never used the toilet; he never felt hungry or sleepy, and in fact, he didn't even know what sleeping was.

[P8] During the day, it's hard to see the water boy. Under the sun, his hands slowly evaporate, his hair gradually disappears, and his feet become damp. At that time, he quickly hides in the shade to rest for a while. Gradually, the water boy returns to his clear, transparent blue.
On cloudy days, the water boy feels most comfortable, and his delicate outline becomes clearly visible.
The water boy never feels thirsty, never takes a bath, and never uses the toilet; he never gets hungry or tired, and in fact, he doesn't even know what sleeping is.

[P9] On the street, if a passerby spotted the water boy, they would point and shout:
"Here he is, call the police!"
"Catch him, go get a bucket, don't forget to call the plumber!"
For several weeks, people drove water tankers and pumps everywhere searching for the water boy. As soon as they saw his shadow, they would sound the alarm.

Each time, the water boy could cleverly avoid the chase:
Sometimes hiding at the bottom of a well, sometimes curling up inside a bottle,
sometimes rushing into puddles, ditches, or even sewers. After the chaos passed, he would slowly crawl out of the dirty water, cleaning off the plastic bags, broken stones, and chewed gum stuck to his body.

[P10] Every day, the water boy hides everywhere, living a hard life. His appearance is so different—
Sometimes, he looks like a plastic bottle with legs;
Sometimes, he looks like a shopping bag filled with seawater;
Sometimes, he looks more like a jellyfish who's been wronged and is sulking.
The water boy, he is a miracle of nature...

[P11] Finally, people slowly came to understand the water boy. At night, the sprinkler truck would ask him for some water to drink — they thought the water the water boy gave was the best, sweet and delicious.
Children also opened their arms and said to the water boy:
"Hello, could you give us a little water, please?"
The water boy smiled; he never refused the children's requests.

[P12] One day, dark clouds gathered, lightning flashed, and thunder roared as a heavy rainstorm arrived. Huge raindrops pounded the entire city, and every street and alley was covered in water. As the rain grew heavier, the water boy was overjoyed. He stepped into the rain, filled with delight. At that moment, a strange voice echoed in his ears: "Come back, come back to us!"
His companions from the water world were calling him. That voice drifted through the streams in the alleys and echoed within millions of raindrops.
"Come back, come back to us! That world full of cars and houses doesn't belong to you. Our home is in the oceans, in the rivers.
"You belong to lakes, streams, springs, raindrops... Come back quickly, water boy, leave that strange world!"

[P13] Whispers came from the wind and rain, surrounding him, chasing him, calling to him. But the water boy liked this world. He decided to leave the city; the first village he met would become his new home.

The water boy ran and ran, raindrops falling on him, the voices of his water world companions faintly in his ears:

Come back, come back...

[P14] Walking along, the water boy came upon a small village. There was a stone fountain in the village, and inside the fountain stood a stone statue...
It was a little boy urinating.
This fountain hadn't been used for a long time. As soon as the water boy jumped in, the fountain instantly came back to life. Water sprayed out from the little boy's statue, merging with the water boy. The fountain became the water boy's new home. The stone carving, the grass by the pool, the red goldfish—life surged vibrantly in all of it, cycling endlessly.

[P15] If, one day, you come to this small village, be sure to visit this fountain. If, one day, you see this fountain, be sure to stay a while. Perhaps you will see the water boy's faint smile in the fountain.
Sometimes, the water boy will come out of the fountain to stretch his limbs. Sometimes, the water boy will look at this world just like we do. When it's quiet at night, you might even spot the water boy's figure. Some swear the water boy comes out for a walk every evening.
But I have never seen him...
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《水男孩和他的喷泉》的封面，画面中一个由金属水壶构成的喷泉从水中升起，水下可见男孩的脚和手，周围有小鱼和纸船游动，整体呈现梦幻的水下世界。
[P2] 本页为绘本《水男孩和他的喷泉》的扉页，展示了书名、作者、绘者、译者及出版社信息，画面中央是一座从水中喷涌而出的房屋状喷泉，背景为朦胧的水雾。
[P3] 本页描述了因水龙头未关紧，水滴日积月累最终凝聚成一个蓝色透明的水男孩，并在醒来后自言自语，困惑于自己是如何出现的。
[P4] 水男孩走出家门，进入真实世界，人们对他感到好奇和惊慌，有人认为他是水坑或幻觉，并阻止他随意走动，甚至有人喊着要报警。
[P5] 水男孩在街上打喷嚏引发巨浪，导致门廊被淹，引起看门大婶和一位戴高帽男子的愤怒，人们对他不穿衣服感到不解并质问。
[P6] 水男孩失踪后被通缉，人们被警告不要接近他。夜晚，他悄悄出现，默默为花草、汽车、小狗和流浪汉提供帮助，用心感受世界。
[P7] 本页描述了水男孩在白天阳光下会蒸发、需躲进阴影休息，阴天时则感觉舒适，且他从不口渴、洗澡、上厕所，也不会饿或困，甚至不知道睡觉是什么。
[P8] 本页描述了水男孩在阳光下会蒸发、需躲进阴影休息，阴天时则感觉舒适，且他从不口渴、洗澡、上厕所，也不会饿或困，甚至不知道睡觉是什么。
[P9] 本页描述了人们发现水男孩后惊慌报警并四处搜捕，而水男孩则巧妙地躲藏在井底、瓶子、水坑或下水道中，待混乱平息后才从脏水中爬出清理自己。
[P10] 本页描述了水男孩因外形奇特而不得不四处躲藏的辛苦生活，他有时像塑料瓶、购物袋或海蜇，被形容为自然的奇迹。
[P11] 人们逐渐接受了水男孩，晚上洒水车和孩子们都向他要水，水男孩总是微笑着满足他们的请求。
[P12] 在一场大暴雨中，水男孩感到开心，但同时听到了来自水世界的呼唤，伙伴们邀请他回到属于水的家园，如湖泊、溪流和海洋，离开人类世界。
[P13] 水男孩在风雨中听到水世界伙伴的呼唤，但他选择留在人类世界，决定离开城市，寻找第一个遇见的村庄作为新家。
[P14] 水男孩来到一个小村庄，跳进一个废弃的石头喷泉，喷泉因此重新焕发活力，成为他的新家，周围的生命也重新循环起来。
[P15] 本页描绘了水男孩在村庄喷泉中安家后的生活，文字邀请读者去探访喷泉，或许能见到水男孩若隐若现的身影，但叙述者表示自己从未亲眼见过他。
[P16] 画面中，一只蓝色的手握着金属洒水壶，向红色背景下的白色花朵喷洒蓝色水流，花丛中游动着几条蓝色小鱼，象征水男孩与自然的和谐共生。
